title: Dash Display and Across-Dash Trim
summary: Feedback on the G60 dash area centers on appreciation for the long or larger display, while several other mentions describe dash layouts or trim without a clear evaluative stance.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the long across-dash display and the larger dash screen area, with one fragment also expressing a desire for more customizable lighting effects across the dash and doors.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the dash display, multiple display layouts, a glossy strip across the dash, and a requested dash storage compartment without enough context to assign clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: Several fragments are very short or descriptive only, which limits confidence in interpreting sentiment beyond the assigned labels.
The topic includes somewhat different dash-related subjects, including display layout, trim finish, ambient lighting, and storage, so the cluster is not fully uniform.
